command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true >/dev/null; sleep 8; echo '=== offcall probe ==='; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'AiCallBridge.*(shizuku_probe_result|probe=|error=|binder_ping=|service_uid=|service_pid=|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|privileged_uid=|offcall_parity_ok=)' | tail -n 120 || true); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'error='; then exit 31; fi; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'offcall_parity_ok=true'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -Eq 'service_uid=2000|privileged_uid=2000'; echo phase2c_binder_looper_offcall_ok=true
